_meta.source: CreateCompanion curated catalog (which itself incorporates https://github.com/waldobronchart/ShortcutMapper), plus hand-authored entries with per-app sources; merged with the earlier direct ShortcutMapper import, which stays deeper on the apps they share
_meta.license: MIT (see the upstream repositories); shortcut data is theirs, the chord/byte transposition is ours
_meta.note: Chords are translated from human notation into the device vocabulary and every one is validated through remap.encode_keypress. Multi-step sequences and anything using Fn are dropped: one binding is one record, and an entry that cannot be flashed is worse than a missing one.
